summary: Iter 7: Regressed + extended backend tests to 52 passing (added 10 new: pdf-search basic/paraphrase/empty-query/k-clamps/cache+TTL/job-log, billing/methods shape, razorpay available=false, razorpay order/verify 503). Frontend verified: /pricing shows gateway-selector with opt-stripe + opt-razorpay (razorpay disabled), paid-price $1, geo=US, unlock-btn labelled 'Unlock lifetime · $1'. /t/pdf-search renders Semantic Search title, opt-query/opt-k inputs, file upload → search-result-0..N cards showing page, score, snippet; model reported as baai/bge-small-en-v1.5. Semantic paraphrase works ('earnings' → p.3, 'company leader' → p.1).

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid='razorpay-unavailable' message never renders because the message is gated behind `gateway === 'razorpay' && !available`, but the Razorpay button is disabled (dim=true) so it can never be selected. The 'unavailable' subtext inside the card itself does render, but the explicit testid element does not. Either (a) render the razorpay-unavailable message unconditionally when the gateway is unavailable, or (b) allow selecting razorpay and let the message explain fallback.
Copy still says '45 tools' / '01 / 45' / 'All 12 in-browser tools' — should be updated to 46 tools now that pdf-search was added (search category also new).

action_items: Optional UX: make data-testid='razorpay-unavailable' render whenever the razorpay gateway is not available (currently unreachable because the option is disabled and cannot be selected).
Copy update: bump '45 tools' references to '46 tools' across Landing.jsx, Unlocked.jsx, DropZone.jsx, and the '12 in-browser tools' phrase in Pricing.jsx free-card feature list.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: pdf-search route rounds scores to 3 decimals which is fine, but the spec asked for floats in [-1,1]. All good — verified in tests.
razorpay_gw.py: verify endpoint reads RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET assuming rzp_available() gate; safe. HMAC uses compare_digest — good.
rag.py: fastembed model is warmed at startup via asyncio.to_thread; but heavy blocking model download on first call may extend cold start. Consider a health-gate.
server.py duplicates FILE_TTL_HOURS with rag.py (both read env) — acceptable but risks drift.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for core flows (pricing gateway selector + pdf-search end-to-end)

test_credentials: test1@ughpdf.com / testpass123 (Free); ad-hoc lifetime users created via /api/billing/mock-unlock in tests.
seed_data_creation: None persistent — tests create ephemeral users (test_/life_/iso_/big_/lim_/co_/pay_/delall_) with random hex suffixes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 52 tests covering pdf-search (semantic + cache + TTL) and Razorpay endpoints in unavailable state. If RAZORPAY_KEY_ID gets set, the '503 when unconfigured' tests need to be adjusted, and add a real order-creation test. FastEmbed model downloads once (~30MB) — first pdf-search call after container restart may be slow. Screenshots saved at /app/test_reports/pricing.png and /app/test_reports/tool-search.png.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions; only minor UX copy staleness (45 vs 46) and a dead code path for razorpay-unavailable testid.
